profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at PrizeLogic
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history working within the computer software and game development industries. Skilled primarily in .NET Languages, REST APIs using .Net Core, and various Windows SDKs. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Game and Simulation Programming from DeVry University Phoenix. Through a background working with clients, I have become familiar with project creation from inception to completion through great consumer relations. I was taught a great deal about the evolution of products first hand from both large and small projects.

- Located in Phoenix, Arizona
- Approximately 9 years of real-world programming experience (7+ years desktop/web/mobile software, 2+ game development). 
I am confident in my ability to learn new skills as well as adapt to the ever growing speed of the software industry. I feel most productive in an environment where I can expand my knowledge, create lasting relationships with team members and produce a product that will show the industry innovation can still be attained.

Programming/Scripting Languages:
C# (.Net Core/Framework)
C++
VB, VBA
PHP
SQL
LUA
Java
HTML
CSS
JQuery
React
Node

Source Control:
Team Foundation Server
GIT (via bitbucket and github using SmartGit software)

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Assigned multiple projects which include internal and external applications. Using a C# ASP.NET stack I utilize the existing database to update the projects according to new features. Other requirements have me creating the database structure from the ground up as well as the application structure.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Was brought on as a secondary help for clientele work that included mostly IT Support style jobs. This was on a call to call basis where I would either work from home or drive out to the client's office. Some of these jobs required that we format all computers within a network and connect them either to an old server or a new one if required. Other work included updating websites where graphics and other resources were handed to us and it was our job to replace the old material with the newly provided material.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recovery Connect App Exchange
A desktop application which increases field visibility and tracks recoveries in real-time to enable greater control of recovery operations. The Recovery Connect software suite is a completely integrated solution that offers an extensive line of assignment management capabilities including immediate notifications of updates and recoveries from the field. The software suite also provides access to functionality that allows vendors and lenders to log in to one central location to process the recovery of an asset through various stages in the asset recovery life span. This included the ability to leave notes, complete actions and tasks,
monitor the pickup of an asset using GPS locations among many other features. The application also hosted an array of “modules” that allowed the vendor or lender to choose specific features that they wanted/needed. This was combined with a companion mobile application that was for both Android and iOS.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Worked on two social mobile games from conception up until the company disbanded. The games were written using ActionScript 3.0 with a MySql backend via php access. I was primarily in charge of the backend where ActionScript communicated through php to the database. If needed I was also in charge of UI/Graphics and extracting them from either the Illustrator/Photoshop file and pushing them into the games.

positions.title: Self Employed
positions.description: Various small client projects that required several pages be added to their current site and mostly included an integration with an existing framework. All files were provided as Photoshop or Illustrator documents and needed to include prior coding standards.

positions.title: Computer Merchandiser
positions.description: Assisted customers in finding their technological needs as well as ensure the shelves were stocked with available merchandise at all times. Also aided in cashier duties from time to time when needed.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Aided local high school students in different courses ranging from Algebra I all the way to Trigonometry. Occasionally, i would also assist in other subjects such as English.
